rows.quote: Undertaking a data-driven, proteome-wide approach to understand the protein signatures in dementia, this study used the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) as the discovery cohort, and subsequently the UK Biobank (UKB) as the validation cohort, to estimate the associations between proteins and the risk of incident all-cause dementia (ACD), and dementia subtypes.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the discovery cohort; the dictionary has no row for it.
The abstract describes a validation cohort analysis in UK Biobank with its participant count; no GWAS release, accession or citation of a dictionary row.
